# ankra_application_database_backup (Resource)

An application's database backup default (`ankra application database-backup set`): whether the database the application ships is protected by default where it is deployed. Setting it needs `backups.manage`. Destroy leaves the default as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application_database_backup" "web" {
  application_id = ankra_application.web.id
  enabled        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Identifier of the application. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the application's database is backed up by default.

### Read-Only

- `database_status` (String) Whether the application ships a database, as the platform detects it.
- `id` (String) The application id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by application id.
terraform import ankra_application_database_backup.web 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10
```
